environment.description: Service runs in EKS cluster behind an internal NLB (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/net/metrics-nlb/a1b2c3d4e5f6). The NLB target group health check path is /health. Network access is controlled via VPC Security Group sg-0f8e2d4a attached to the NLB ENIs, which has inbound rules permitting TCP 8443 only from three specific CIDR blocks: 10.100.0.0/16 (internal service mesh), 172.20.0.0/14 (corporate VPN egress), and 192.168.50.0/24 (monitoring subnet). The NLB is type 'internal' (scheme=internal, no public DNS resolution). Additionally, a Network ACL (acl-0b7a3e9f) on the NLB subnet denies all inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 except the three listed CIDRs. Pod runs with securityContext.runAsNonRoot=true (UID 65534). Note: the service still accepts all WebSocket origins and performs no authentication on the gob-decoded commands — the trust boundary is entirely at the network perimeter.

config.network: internal NLB, scheme=internal, no internet-facing endpoint
config.service_mesh: no mTLS enforcement on this port
